title: SIMS: Social Impact Mapping Simulation
summary: A browser simulation of two-party elections where voters shift stance over time based on social influence. Grounded in Social Impact Theory (Nowak, Szamrej & Latané, 1990).

title: Is Juan dela Cruz Better Than Johnny at Jailbreaking LLMs?
summary: An extension of Zeng et al. (2024) on Persuasive Adversarial Prompts. Generates Filipino PAP to test AI model vulnerabilities to jailbreak. TARA final project.
